finePrint.summary: All fees are non-cancelable and non-refundable by default, which is risky for a lifetime-deal buyer.

quote.text: All fees are stated and solely payable in U.S. Dollars (unless otherwise stated during the payment process), non-cancelable, non-refundable (except as otherwise expressly set forth in these Terms), and not subject to setoff.

finePrint.summary: Canceling a subscription does not refund the current period, so buyers should not expect pro-rata refunds.

quote.text: YOU WILL NOT RECEIVE A REFUND OF ANY PORTION OF THE SUBSCRIPTION FEE PAID FOR THE THEN-CURRENT SUBSCRIPTION PERIOD AT THE TIME OF CANCELLATION.

themes.summary: Several buyers say their codes never activated and support stopped replying for weeks or months.
